request.title: Normalize errors, not presentation

scenarios.badRequestDescription: HTTP 400 for malformed or invalid request parameters.

scenarios.notFoundDescription: HTTP 404 for deleted resources or invalid addresses.
scenarios.conflictDescription: HTTP 409 for concurrent updates or unique-key conflicts.
scenarios.validationDescription: HTTP 200 with business code 422 becomes a business error in the interceptor.
scenarios.serverErrorDescription: HTTP 500 keeps retry and diagnostic details available to the page.
scenarios.timeoutDescription: A short timeout verifies timeout error normalization.
